G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(11))
G.add_edges_from(edges)

print("Nodes:", G.number_of_nodes())
print("Min degree:", min(dict(G.degree()).values()))
print("Max clique:", nx.algorithms.clique.graph_clique_number(G))
print("Chromatic number:", nx.algorithms.coloring.greedy_color(G, strategy='largest_first'))
